title: CodeAtlas File Schema
description: Schema defining a file index entry, connecting a file path to its technical and semantic roles.

type.description: The logical type or category of file (e.g., component, hook, page, service, store, utility, style, config).

technical_role.description: Technical responsibilities of this file (e.g., 'Renders individual project thumbnails with responsive padding').

semantic_role.description: Human-readable semantic purpose (e.g., 'Represents a single project card in the featured and recommended collections').

features.description: List of Feature IDs that this file directly supports or implements.

imports.description: List of files or dependencies imported by this file.

imported_by.description: List of files that import this file.

dependencies.description: External library or packages imported by this file (e.g., 'react', 'lodash').

notes.description: Developer or agent observation notes regarding code stability or patterns.
